newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL'S KOP TO GET BILL SHANKLY STATUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL'S KOP TO GET BILL SHANKLY STATUE.

text.p: Bill Shankly is coming home to Liverpool.
A 2.28-metre statue of the legendary soccer manager is to get a permanent home behind the Kop, the Anfield stand in which the club's supporters gather for home games.
The bronze statue, paid for by the club's sponsors, will bear the legend: "Shankly -- he made the people happy".
Shankly was boss at Anfield from 1959 to 1974, leading his club to the first division title three times, the English F.A. Cup twice and the UEFA cup once, in 1973. He died of a heart attack in 1981.
